# أدواتي — Adawati Tools

> Free Arabic-first online tools for Oman and the Arab world. 29 tools covering finance, health, files, images, and games. Available in 6 languages (Arabic, English, French, Spanish, German, Russian). No login required, fully client-side, privacy-first.

## Finance & Salary Tools (Oman)
- [End of Service Calculator](https://adawati.space/end-of-service.html): Oman end-of-service gratuity calculator per Article 61 of the updated Labour Law. Covers Omani nationals (SPF) and expats. Compares old vs new system.
- [Salary Calculator](https://adawati.space/salary-calculator.html): Oman salary calculator with Social Protection Fund (SPF) deduction. Uses insurable wage with OMR 3,000 ceiling per SPF rules.
- [Currency Converter](https://adawati.space/currency-converter.html): Live exchange rates from ExchangeRate-API, updated every 4 hours. Covers 30+ currencies including OMR, SAR, AED, USD, EUR, GBP, EGP, INR.
- [VAT Calculator](https://adawati.space/vat-calculator.html): Oman VAT calculator (5%). Add or remove VAT from any price.
- [Loan Calculator](https://adawati.space/loan-calculator.html): Monthly installment calculator with full amortization schedule. Supports early repayment simulation.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://adawati.space/compound-interest.html): Investment growth calculator with compound interest and regular contributions.
- [Discount Calculator](https://adawati.space/discount-calculator.html): Calculate price after discount percentage.
- [Tip Calculator](https://adawati.space/tip-calculator.html): Split bills and calculate tip amounts.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://adawati.space/percentage-calculator.html): Percentage increase, decrease, and ratio calculations.

## Health Tools
- [BMI Calculator](https://adawati.space/bmi-calculator.html): Body Mass Index calculator with WHO classification table, formula explanation, and FAQ. Supports kg/cm and lb/in.
- [Diet Plan](https://adawati.space/diet-plan.html): Personalized daily calorie and macro calculator based on age, weight, height, and activity level.

## Conversion & Date Tools
- [Unit Converter](https://adawati.space/unit-converter.html): Length, weight, temperature, area, volume conversions.
- [Hijri Date Converter](https://adawati.space/hijri-converter.html): Convert between Hijri (Islamic) and Gregorian calendar dates.
- [Age Calculator](https://adawati.space/age-calculator.html): Calculate exact age in years, months, and days.
- [Date Difference](https://adawati.space/date-diff.html): Number of days between two dates.
- [Timezone Converter](https://adawati.space/timezone-converter.html): Convert time between world timezones.

## File & Image Tools
- [File Converter](https://adawati.space/file-converter.html): Client-side file conversion — Word, Excel, CSV, PDF, images (JPG, PNG, WebP). No upload to server.
- [Image Compressor](https://adawati.space/image-compressor.html): Compress images in the browser without uploading. Supports JPG, PNG, WebP.
- [QR Generator](https://adawati.space/qr-generator.html): Generate QR codes for any URL or text.

## Utility Tools
- [Password Generator](https://adawati.space/password-generator.html): Generate secure random passwords with custom length and character sets.
- [Word Counter](https://adawati.space/word-counter.html): Count words, characters, sentences, and reading time.
- [Random Number Generator](https://adawati.space/random-number.html): Generate random numbers in a custom range.
- [Stopwatch](https://adawati.space/stopwatch.html): Precise stopwatch with lap timer.

## Games
- [Number Guessing Game](https://adawati.space/number-guess.html): Guess the random number with hints.
- [Memory Card Game](https://adawati.space/memory-game.html): Flip cards memory matching game.
- [Quick Math](https://adawati.space/quick-math.html): Speed arithmetic training game.
- [Reaction Test](https://adawati.space/reaction-test.html): Measure your reaction time in milliseconds.
- [Car Game](https://adawati.space/car-game.html): Browser-based car dodging game.
- [Jump Game](https://adawati.space/jump-game.html): Side-scrolling jump game.
- [Kids Learn](https://adawati.space/kids-learn.html): Educational tool for children — letters, numbers, colors.

- [About Adawati](https://adawati.space/about.html): About this free Arabic tool collection.
- [Privacy Policy](https://adawati.space/privacy.html): No data collection, no accounts, fully client-side.
